The noisy weight is hand-set (marked); the run and the experiment are real.
Keep the trend, drop the jitter

The weights jump a little after every training step, partly toward better and partly at random. An exponential moving average (EMA) keeps a second copy that moves only a small step toward the latest weights each time, so the jitter averages out.
